name: Tiffany Thurston
occupation: Niobrara County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Tiffany Thurston is a Niobrara County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Patrick Wade, who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 general election summary lists her with 787 votes, alongside Kevin H. Baars at 685.
